title: Charlie Spivak and Frank Horne's coffee sessions
summary: Charlie Spivak and his band visit Pensacola and gather at Frank Horne's house, where Spivak asks Brownlee about old-timers.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: has his own band well he's Charlie Spivak man good thing you got a good retentive mind and a memory Charlie Spivak he was at the Rose Pelton not so long ago I think he may still be there as far as I know
I don't believe well he was there last month he was there when Hackett was downtown I met some of the guys out of his band

uh huh well I knew Sal and all that bunch in his band and usually when they come in here to play here we all go out to Frank's house after the job Frank Horne's house we'd have a little coffee session and what not sit around talk play tapes and uh Charlie used to quiz me about some of the old timers he'd get a big kick out of me
